name: HAL Dhruv / Rudra
armament: Rudra (ALH Mk IV WSI): 20 mm chin cannon, 70 mm rockets, Helina ATGM
protection: Game: airframe immune to small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm damage rotor, engines and cockpit glass (forced landing on accumulated hits); launchers and MANPADS (off-list) destroy it.
visual_notes: Twin-engine utility helicopter with a rounded cabin and four-blade hingeless rotor
Skid (army) or wheeled gear (air force/navy) versions
Rudra: stub wings and chin gun turret
